g.text: Research Desk demo team: bounded critique cycle with RAG and a human gate
The revise back-edge crosses a bounded transition, so every
hot cycle has a progress boundary. Deploying without the
bound is rejected with the diagnostic cycle-without-progress;
exhausting it rewrites the token disposition to iterationLimit
at the decide node, which routes to the human gate.
Both services are replay-cached non-deterministic system
processes on the validator: the first execution records the
observed result on chain and replay returns the recording.
The Archive edge writes the same collection the Draft edge
